svg.title: One flat map for two curved surfaces
svg.desc: Schematic, not computed from the robot. Two shaded curved surfaces float one above the other over a flat grid, their shared map. A straight dashed line on the map appears on each surface as a different curved route. A ring marks the same point on all three, joined by a dashed vertical, with its three coordinates beside each surface and its two beside the map.
svg.text: ONE FLAT MAP FOR TWO CURVED SURFACES / SCHEMATIC
